rows.exact_construct: ISCO-08 groups 25 and 35 employment stock, tested as share, log scale and equal blend.
rows.does_not_mean: Live vacancies, hiring demand, job quality or applicant probability.
rows.metric: Diagnostic equal blend of share and log employment scale
rows.correlation_risks: Scale component overlaps population and overall employment depth.
rows.conditions: Fails 82-country minimum; a new official edition/source must reach the policy without imputation.

rows.conditions: Fails 82-country minimum; three-digit table is unavailable, so the public name must remain science and engineering.

rows.exact_construct: Target is scale plus specialization; exact current source supplies only graduate share for ISCED 5-8 field 700.

rows.metric: Capacity metric not constructible; share-only diagnostic tested
rows.correlation_risks: Share alone rewards specialization without proving scale.
rows.conditions: Need compatible field counts or field share plus total graduates, at least 82 fresh countries, and ShareAlike disposition.

rows.conditions: Pin an OpenAlex capture, accept acquisition cost/key requirement, retain ROR, and build deterministic institution-to-GHSL mapping.
